title: Create Big Cannons FTB Claims Protection
description: Makes Create Big Cannons respect FTB Chunks claims — tied to each team's "Allow explosions" toggle.
body:
# Cannonproof Claims

FTB Chunks stops TNT from blowing up your claims, but Create Big Cannons breaks blocks with its own code that FTB Chunks never sees — so cannons demolish protected bases anyway. **Cannonproof Claims** fixes that.

Cannon block damage is tied to each team's existing **"Allow explosions"** toggle (`ftbchunks:allow_explosions`) — the same switch that already controls TNT:

- **Off** (default) → cannons can't break blocks in that team's claims.
- **On** → cannons (and TNT) can.

Set it in the FTB Teams settings screen as usual. Cannons still fire, fly, and damage players and entities — they just can't grief protected builds.

## Requirements
- Minecraft **1.21.1**, **NeoForge**
- **Create Big Cannons**
- **FTB Chunks**

## Install
Drop the jar in `mods`. Protection runs server-side, but install it on **both** the server and clients (NeoForge requires matching mod lists). Works in singleplayer too.
